title: Add White Plaid Lace and Dark Stussy Grunge wallpapers to collection

requirements.summary: Add 'whitePlaidLace' and 'darkStussyGrunge' texture keys to usePersonalization hook's texture options map
acceptanceCriteria: usePersonalization hook includes 'whitePlaidLace' and 'darkStussyGrunge' as valid texture keys
Each key maps to the correct asset path under frontend/public/assets/generated

file_operations.description: Add two new entries to the texture options map: 'whitePlaidLace' pointing to '/assets/generated/white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg' and 'darkStussyGrunge' pointing to '/assets/generated/dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg', maintaining consistency with existing texture key naming and URL format

requirements.summary: Add White Plaid Lace and Dark Stussy Grunge thumbnail options to PersonalizationPanel component
acceptanceCriteria: PersonalizationPanel displays thumbnails for both new wallpapers
Selecting either new wallpaper applies it as the app background
Layout remains a 4-column grid consistent with existing options

file_operations.description: Add two new wallpaper thumbnail buttons in the grid: one for 'whitePlaidLace' using frontend/public/assets/generated/white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg and one for 'darkStussyGrunge' using frontend/public/assets/generated/dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg, positioned after the existing 8 wallpaper options and maintaining the 4-column responsive grid layout with proper onClick handlers to set the texture

requirements.summary: Add White Plaid Lace and Dark Stussy Grunge selectable options to Personalization page
acceptanceCriteria: Personalization page shows both new wallpaper thumbnails
Selecting them updates the persisted background preference

file_operations.description: Add two new wallpaper thumbnail buttons to the texture selection grid: one for 'whitePlaidLace' using frontend/public/assets/generated/white-plaid-lace.dim_1280x720.jpg and one for 'darkStussyGrunge' using frontend/public/assets/generated/dark-stussy-grunge.dim_1280x720.jpg, positioned after the existing 8 options and maintaining consistent thumbnail styling with active state indicators and onClick handlers

requirements.summary: Wire generated wallpaper images as static frontend assets
acceptanceCriteria: Both image files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated
Images load correctly when applied as background in the app

file_operations.description: Place the generated white plaid lace wallpaper image (light gray diagonal plaid pattern with black lace trim along the bottom edge, clean and delicate textile aesthetic) as a static asset at this path so it can be referenced by the personalization hook and components

Place the generated dark Stussy grunge wallpaper image (high-contrast black background with large off-white Stussy graffiti-style logo text on the left and a close-up of bared teeth on the right, grungy streetwear aesthetic) as a static asset at this path so it can be referenced by the personalization hook and components
